title: Embedding-degree sparsity: at most M(M+1) bad traces
question: Fix a prime power q and M >= 1. Call an integer t with |t| <= 2 sqrt(q) M-bad if q+1-t has a prime factor r > 4 sqrt(q) with r not dividing q and multiplicative order of q mod r at most M. Then the number of M-bad t is at most M(M+1).
rationale: Registered by PI from sealed round-1 submissions before cross-agent synthesis or review.
